content: I haven't seen this mentioned here. You can get immediate (<2h) excellent LLM review on your human/AI preprint at aixiv.science . Their paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15126
Edit: you do not get a DOI, but that's good because, after some reviewing rounds, you can submit to other venues without having duplicate DOIs.

Ralf Stephan 发言道：

I haven't seen this mentioned here. You can get immediate (<2h) excellent LLM review on your human/AI preprint at aixiv.science . Their paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15126

I think it would be better if there were an MCP and a CLI.
For the moment the reviews are partly aimed at submission to AI/ML journals, but they said in a mail that they will provide other field-specific reviews soon.
